brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor — depth and opacity convincingly suggest a temporal 3D space where recent notes float forward
Restrained dark palette with subtle violet accents creates focused, contemplative atmosphere appropriate for thought capture
Clear typographic hierarchy within cards: title, body, timestamp, tag pill all read at correct weights
dominant_weaknesses: Connection threads are barely visible — the core 'threads between concepts' promise of the brief is underdelivered visually
Toolbar floats as a flat 2D panel disconnected from the 3D scene language, breaking the spatial illusion
Timeline scrubber on the left is cryptic with no labels, ticks, or affordance explaining its function
fix_priorities: Make connection threads first-class: glowing bezier links with varying opacity tied to relationship strength
Integrate toolbar into the spatial system (depth, glass, or anchored chrome) so it doesn't feel pasted on
Label the timeline scrubber and add hover scrubbing preview to teach the time dimension
Increase parallax/scale differentiation between near and far notes to amplify the depth metaphor
rationale.norman_balance: Strong reflective concept and decent visceral mood, but behavioral clarity lags due to undiscoverable controls and weak thread visualization.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the floating-in-space metaphor convincingly but underdelivers the 'threads between notes' half of the brief.
